articles.title: Polar Capital's $12B Fund Dumps Software as ETF Falls 22%
articles.mainIdea: Polar Capital's $12B Fund Dumps Software as ETF Falls 22%
articles.summary: GuruFocus.com: Polar Capital's $12B Fund Dumps Software as ETF Falls 22%. This article first appeared on GuruFocus. Nick Evans, who oversees a $12 billion global technology fund at Polar Capital, is making a decisive call on the future of software. After outperforming 99% of peers over one year and 97% over five, Evans argues that application software could be facing what he describes as an existential threat from artificial intelligence. Related tickers mentioned: ANTH.PVT, HUBS, MSFT, NOW, SAP.
